annotations.title: Accessible grating opening checker (13 mm rule)

description: Checks the clear opening between bearing bars against the Ontario Building Code 13 mm limit for barrier-free paths of travel, and the widest bar spacing that would pass.

bar_thickness_in.description: Bearing bar thickness in inches, for example 0.125 (1/8), 0.1875 (3/16), 0.25 (1/4).

pattern.description: 19-W-4 (1-3/16 in centres), 15-W-4 (15/16 in centres) or custom (give spacing_in).

spacing_in.description: Bearing bar centre-to-centre spacing in inches. Required when pattern is custom.

name: accessible_grating_opening_checker
